thread:
Mike: Heads-up — prepping release notes for v2.4.0. Need a quick sync on internal announcement timing, pinning, and rollback lanes. Target launch Wed 09:00 PT. thoughts?
Sarah: Wed 09:00 PT is Wed 16:00 UTC — noted. Recommend a short embargo +24h for metrics stability. Who owns the pinned audience?
Jessie: Can we pin to internal staff first, then ramp to customers? Also propose rollback criteria: sustained error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +200ms for 10m => rollback.
product-comm: I can draft the internal blurb. Need final bulleted user-facing changes + list of affected routes by EOD Mon.
Lina: Suggested blurb: "Rolling out v2.4.0 — improved batching heuristics (10-20% cost improvement), faster cold-starts, and fixes for cache invalidation". Thoughts? :sparkles:
Mike: Looks good. Add a short note about the opt-in quantization profile for Dedicated customers.
deploy-bot: Canary schedule ready. Run command: `./deploy --version v2.4.0 --canary 5% --duration 30m`
oncall-sre: I'll own the oncall rota during rollout. Canary monitor: alert if 5xx rate >0.3% OR latency p95 +150ms. Rolling back if sustained for 5m.
Jessie: Confirm automated rollback triggers exist in the deploy config and that manual rollback steps are in the runbook.
Mike: Manual rollback steps are in the runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/release-rollback (internal).
product-comm: Timeline: need final copy by Tue 18:00 PT so we can push internal announce Wed 08:30 PT.
Sarah: Also need to confirm version pinning matrix — Dedicated customers remain pinned to v2.3 unless they opt-in. We should flag pinned routes in the console before launch.
Lina: I'll update the draft and add a "What to watch" section (KPIs, customer impact, contact points).
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: `helm test release-v2.4.0` -> linter OK, no API diffs detected.
Mike: Who owns the release-note microcopy + short FAQ? @product-comm?
product-comm: I'll take microcopy + FAQ. Send any technical bullets or edge-case notes via DM.
Jessie: One more item — include a note about automatic fallback to a smaller model variant if capacity constrained.
Mike: Good call, add that to the blurb and ops checklist.
oncall-sre: Tagging owners for the deploy window: @oncall-sre @infra-lead @deploy-eng — I'll be in the channel during deploy.
deploy-bot: Will post deploy cues at T-30m and T-5m in #eng-releases :bell:
product-comm: Approved internal blurb: "v2.4.0 rolling out Wed 09:00 PT. Expect a short canary window; reach out to #support if you see regressions."
Lina: Final copy pushed to draft: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.4.0/internal-blurb.md
Mike: Final checklist: canary job green, docs link live, release note approved, pin matrix updated. If all green, I'll start deploy.
Sarah: +1 — I'll watch metrics during and after rollout.
oncall-sre: Oncall will monitor alerts and be ready to execute rollback. Set nowbridge to oncall alias.
Mike: Thanks team — will run preflight at T-60m and confirm here.
